ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.4.4 (TieJin Modify) 文化拓展、仪式演化点与医美应用。新增功能仅限 RimWorld 1.7，1.6／Common 保留 SSC 2.4.1 冻结基线。 主奴秩序模因与六组28条戒律，配合心情、社交、领袖、数量及性别反馈，专属图标、四语命名与动态背景。仪式演化点默认关闭，开启后遵循原版发展条件与改革上限。 医美手术与塑貌仪式可将原版Beauty逐档提升至+2，配套材料、恢复反应、紫雾和命名预设。修复人格排泄固定动作空解析导致的中断。 保留关系概览、低科技路线、九把PNA武器、个体凝胶外观、六种特化、主人资格／成长和人格转移。 升级时完整替换旧模组目录，保留版本目录与LoadFolders.xml。1.7旧简易PNA发射器及相关定义已移除，不提供引用旧定义的存档迁移。 Harmony与RJW先于SSC加载；文化及仪式需要Ideology。兔入口与旧RimTalk对接仍不可用。
Version 2.4.4 — culture, optional ritual development points and cosmetic reshaping. New features target RimWorld 1.7; 1.6/Common remain frozen at SSC 2.4.1. Includes Master-slave Order with six groups/28 precepts, cultural feedback, dedicated icons, four-language naming and dynamic backgrounds. Ritual development points default to off and follow vanilla conditions/caps. Cosmetic surgery and Reshaping Rituals improve vanilla Beauty one step up to +2, with material costs, shared recovery, purple mist and name presets. Fixes Personality Excretion aborting on empty fixed-interaction resolution. Retains bonds, low-tech progression, nine PNA weapons, gel appearance, specializations and personality transfer. Replace the old folder completely; retain version folders/loading configuration. Removed old 1.7 launcher definitions have no save migration. Load Harmony and RJW before SSC. Ideology is required for cultural features and rituals. Rabbit selection and legacy RimTalk remain unavailable.
